phrasings.text: Actually we use fmtDate from src/lib/dates.js for every date, not toLocaleDateString.
Dates always go through fmtDate() in lib/dates.js; the locale functions give different text on every machine.
Please remember: format dates with fmtDate, never toLocaleString or toISOString slices.
Use the dates helper (fmtDate) for that, we never format dates by hand.
